This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)

- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52

              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

38

63	    TransformerBlock35::load(src, prefix, layer_type)

67	        ├─ post_attention_layernorm ← "{prefix}.post_attention_layernorm.weight" # 共有
68	        └─ MLP35::load(src, "{prefix}")                                # 共有
69	```
70

75	for layer in layers:
76	    normed = rms_norm(hidden, layer.input_layernorm)
77	    match layer.attn:
78	        FullAttention(attn)   → 全注意力内核族; full_idx += 1
79	        LinearAttention(attn) → GDN 内核族;     linear_idx += 1
80	    hidden_mid = hidden + attn_out
81	    normed = rms_norm(hidden_mid, layer.post_attention_layernorm)
82	    hidden = hidden_mid + mlp(normed)
83	```

141	### 4.2 全注意力层：gated Q、QK-norm、partial RoPE 与 paged KV
142	
143	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
144	
145	`FullAttentionLayer` 是「标准」Transformer 注意力加三个 Qwen3.5 特有的 twists：
146	
147	1. **gated attention**：`q_proj` 的输出不只含 Q，还含每个 head 的一个**门控标量带**。HF/PegaInfer 的内核把 `q_proj` 的行解释为「每个 head 先 `head_dim` 行 Q、再 `head_dim` 行 gate」的 per-head 交错块（注释见 [src/weights/layers.rs:417-420](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L417-L420)）。注意力算完后用 gate 做 sigmoid 乘法。
148	2. **QK-norm**：Q 和 K 在 RoPE 之前各过一次 head 共享的 RMSNorm（`q_norm`/`k_norm` 都是 `[head_dim]`，广播到所有 head）。
149	3. **partial RoPE**：只旋转每头前 `rotary_dim = head_dim × partial_rotary_factor` 维（u2-l1 已推导），cos/sin 表在模型加载时预计算（[src/weights.rs:240-248](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L240-L248)），属于模型而非层。
150	
151	维度派生（[src/config/model.rs:139-146](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L139-L146)）：`full_attn_q_dim = num_attention_heads × head_dim`，`full_attn_kv_dim = num_key_value_heads × head_dim`。注意 `q_proj` 矩阵的行数是这个的两倍（Q + gate）。GQA：`num_key_value_heads < num_attention_heads` 时多头共享 KV，组比率是 TP 不变量（u2-l2）。

153	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
154	
155	prefill 路径（[src/prefill.rs:305-446](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L305-L446)）：
156	
157	```
158	输入: normed_batch [hidden, seq]
159	1. q_full = gemm(q_proj, normed)        # [heads*head_dim*2, seq]（Q 与 gate 交错）
160	   k     = gemm(k_proj, normed)         # [kv_heads*head_dim, seq]
161	   v     = gemm(v_proj, normed)         # 同上
162	2. 融合预备内核（一个 CUDA kernel 做三件事）:
163	   a. Q/K 各自 RMSNorm（q_norm/k_norm）
164	   b. Q/K 前 rotary_dim 维做 partial RoPE（查 cos/sin 表）
165	   c. K/V 直接写进分页 KV 池（按 page_indices 定位页）
166	   输出 q_prepped
167	3. 批量 paged attention: attn_out = softmax(QK^T/√head_dim)·V
168	4. gate 内核: attn_out *= sigmoid(gate 带来自 q_full)
169	5. out = gemm(o_proj, attn_out) + TP all-reduce
170	```
171	
172	decode 路径（[src/batch_decode.rs:112-214](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L112-L214)）结构相同，差异有二：第 2 步换成 decode 专用融合内核 `qk_norm_partial_rope_batched_decode_hd256_into`——它只做 QK-norm 与 partial RoPE（Q 从交错 `q_full` 取出写入 `q`，K 原地处理），**不碰 KV 池**；落页藏在第 3 步的包装函数里：`paged_attention_batch_decode_hd256_into` 先调 `scatter_decode_kv_into_paged` 把本步 K/V 写入池，再发射注意力内核（[pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/qwen35.rs:205-219](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/qwen35.rs#L205-L219)）。所以两条路径的「谁写池」位置不同：prefill 在 prep 内核、decode 在 attention 包装的开头。第 3 步内核本身二选一：批量小且 GQA 组比率在编译清单内（u2-l2 的 P2c 门）走 split-KV 两阶段归约内核（`paged_attention_batch_decode_split_hd256_into`），否则走单内核。

229	### 4.3 线性注意力层：Gated DeltaNet 的权重与一次前向
230	
231	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
232	
233	`LinearAttentionLayer` 实现的是 Gated DeltaNet。直觉版：每个线性注意力层维护一组 per-head 的**状态矩阵** \( S \)（形状概念上 `[K, V]`），每个 token 到来时做一次「遗忘 + 写入」的递推更新，然后用当前 query 从状态里读出输出。示意形式（本 crate 的精确状态布局与内核数学在 u3-l2 精读，此处只给直觉）：
234	
235	\[ S_t = \alpha_t \cdot S_{t-1} \;(\text{遗忘门衰减}) \; + \; \text{新写入}(\beta_t, \mathbf{k}_t, \mathbf{v}_t), \qquad \mathbf{o}_t = S_t\, \mathbf{q}_t \]
236	
237	其中 \( \alpha_t \) 由 `A_log`/`dt_bias` 参数化的衰减得出，\( \beta_t \) 是写入强度（beta 投影），「Delta Rule」指新写入是对预测误差的修正而非盲目叠加。与传统 RNN 的区别在于更新是**外积形式**的，可以分块（chunkwise）并行——这正是 u1-l2 讲过的 Triton AOT 生成的 GDR chunkwise prefill 内核所做的事。
238	
239	这层的输入侧还有两个配角：
240	
241	- **causal depthwise conv1d**：QKV 投影结果先过一个核宽 4 的因果逐通道卷积（带 `conv_state` 记住跨 chunk 的尾拍），给线性层一点短程上下文记忆；
242	- **gated RMSNorm**：GDN 输出用 z 投影做 SiLU 门控的 RMSNorm（`rms_norm_gated_batch_into`，权重是 head 共享的 `norm_weight`）。
243	
244	与全注意力层最大的结构差异：**这层没有任何 KV cache**。历史全部活在 `RecurrentState`（调度器侧持有）的 `layer_state.state`（f32）与 `layer_state.conv_state`（bf16）里，尺寸恒定。

246	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
247	
248	加载期（[src/weights/layers.rs:148-189](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L148-L189)）——checkpoint 按四个独立投影存储，装载期融合成两个矩阵：
249	
250	```
251	in_proj_qkv + in_proj_z  --vstack-->  in_proj_qkvz   # 行序 [qkv | z]
252	in_proj_b  + in_proj_a   --vstack-->  in_proj_ba     # 行序 [beta | alpha]
253	conv1d.weight   → conv1d_weight（展平 [qkv_dim × kernel_dim]，通道序镜像 qkv 带）
254	dt_bias / A_log → 按 value head 分片（A_log 装载时从 bf16 加宽为 f32）
255	norm.weight     → norm_weight（[value_head_dim] f32，head 共享，整取不切）
256	out_proj        → 列切（行并行：各 rank 出部分 hidden 和，层内 all-reduce）
257	```
258	
259	融合的收益（注释原话）：「one GEMM per group instead of four launches」——decode 路径整层只发 2 次 GEMM 就拿到 qkvz 和 ba。
260	
261	前向期 prefill（[src/prefill.rs:448-552](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L448-L552)）：
262	
263	```
264	输入: normed [hidden, seq]
265	1. qkv = GEMM(in_proj_qkvz 的 [0, qkv_dim) 行带)
266	   z   = GEMM(in_proj_qkvz 的 [qkv_dim, +z_dim) 行带)   # 同一矩阵两次行带读取
267	   b   = GEMM(in_proj_ba 的 [0, H_v) 行带)
268	   a   = GEMM(in_proj_ba 的 [H_v, +H_v) 行带)
269	2. qkv_conv = conv1d(qkv, conv1d_weight)  # 因果逐通道卷积，更新 conv_state
270	3. gdr_out  = GDR chunkwise 内核(qkv_conv, b, a, dt_bias, a_log)  # 读改 layer_state.state
271	4. normed_out = gated RMSNorm(gdr_out, norm_weight, gate=z, act=SiLU)
272	5. out = GEMM(out_proj, normed_out) + TP all-reduce
273	```
274	
275	decode（[src/batch_decode.rs:845-906](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L845-L906)）同样五步，但两处不同：第 1 步对融合矩阵各发**一次**完整 `gemm_into`，之后用 `columns()` 视图切行带（不再分两次 GEMM）；第 2、3 步换成 decode 专用内核，通过**按槽位的设备指针表**（`state_ptrs`/`conv_state_ptrs`）直接寻址每个请求的固定地址状态——这是 CUDA Graph 重放指针稳定性的关键，u4-l3 展开。

277	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
278	
279	权重清单与注释非常完整（[src/weights/layers.rs:30-55](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L30-L55)），几个要点直接读注释即可：
280	
281	- `in_proj_qkvz`：行 `[0, local_linear_qkv_dim)` 是 qkv、之上是 z，行序由 `linear_qkv_shard_segments` 约定；
282	- `in_proj_ba`：行 `[0, H_v)` 是 beta、之上是 alpha；
283	- `conv1d_weight`：从 `[qkv_dim, 1, 4]` 展平，**通道布局镜像 qkv 带**——所以 TP 分片时用与 qkv 相同的段偏移乘上 kernel dim（[src/weights/layers.rs:409-415](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L409-L415)）；
284	- `a_log`/`norm_weight`：bf16 存储在 checkpoint、装载时加宽为 f32（经 `tensor_f32_cow` 路径），因为衰减与 norm 对精度敏感。
285	
286	TP 分片最讲究的是 qkv：checkpoint 把全局行存成 `[所有 q 行 | 所有 k 行 | 所有 v 行]` 三段，每个 rank 从**每段里**切出自己的 head 局部片再拼接，使 rank 拿到的行保持 `[q_local | k_local | v_local]`（[src/weights/layers.rs:386-407](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L386-L407)，注释里点名的「gated-q lesson」：绝不能跨段重排，q 行按 key head 计数、v 行按 value head 计数）。配套单测 [src/weights/layers.rs:473-491](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L473-L491) 用 16k/32v head 的 fixture 验证两 rank 的段拼起来恰好无重叠覆盖全局。
287	
288	维度上，`z` 维 = `linear_num_value_heads × linear_value_head_dim`（[src/config/model.rs:155-157](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L155-L157)），且 local z 维等于 local v 维（[src/config/tp.rs:225-228](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs#L225-L228)）——z 作为门控与 GDN 输出同宽，才能在 gated norm 里逐元素相乘。
289	
290	前向侧的两个状态外置点（[src/prefill.rs:504-514](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L504-L514)）：`layer_state = &mut recurrent.layers[*linear_idx]`，conv 内核拿走 `&mut layer_state.conv_state`，GDR 内核拿走 `&mut layer_state.state`——层结构体 `attn` 自始至终只有不可变借用。GDR chunkwise 调用（[src/prefill.rs:516-531](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L516-L531)）同时吃进 `qkv_conv/b/a/dt_bias/a_log`、输出 `gdr_out` 并原地推进状态。gated norm（[src/prefill.rs:533-544](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L533-L544)）的激活函数显式传 `GatedNormActivation::Silu`。
291	
292	decode 版的行带读取与装载行序的对应关系（[src/batch_decode.rs:858-897](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L858-L897)）：`bufs.qkvz.columns(0, qkv_dim)` 取 qkv 带、`columns(qkv_dim, z_dim)` 取 z 带、`bufs.ba.columns(0, value_heads)` 是 beta、`columns(value_heads, value_heads)` 是 alpha——注释点明「row order is the one the loader stacked the weights in」，装载期融合与消费期行带是同一份契约的两端。
293	
294	#### 4.3.4 代码实践
295	
296	**实践目标**：验证「装载期融合行序」与「前向期行带读取」互相咬合——把 checkpoint 张量名、融合后矩阵的行段、decode 读取带三列对齐。
297	
298	**操作步骤**：
299	
300	1. 从 [src/weights/layers.rs:148-168](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L148-L168) 列出 4 个 checkpoint 张量名（`in_proj_qkv.weight`、`in_proj_z.weight`、`in_proj_b.weight`、`in_proj_a.weight`）与它们 vstack 后的落位。
301	2. 从 [src/batch_decode.rs:860-875](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L860-L875) 抄下 `columns()` 的四组 `(offset, len)` 参数。
302	3. 画一张两行的对照表：上行是 `in_proj_qkvz` 与 `in_proj_ba` 的行段划分，下行是 decode 消费的行带，逐段连线。
303	4. 思考题自检：如果有人把 vstack 顺序改成 `[z | qkv]`，哪些调用点会静默出错？（提示：`gemm_rows_into` 的 offset 参数、`columns()` 的 offset、conv1d 的通道镜像三处。）
304	
305	**需要观察的现象**：没有任何一处代码在运行时「检查」行序——正确性完全靠装载与消费两端的字面约定。这正是注释把行序写进文档字符串的原因。
306	
307	**预期结果**：对照表为 `qkvz: [0, qkv_dim) → conv1d 输入带`、`[qkv_dim, z_dim) → gated norm 的 z 门`；`ba: [0, H_v) → beta`、`[H_v, 2·H_v) → alpha`。若顺序颠倒，prefill 的 `gemm_rows_into`（[src/prefill.rs:468-502](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L468-L502)）会静默读到错误的行带、输出形状却可能仍对——这类 bug 只能靠 u8-l1 的精度门暴露。
308	
309	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
310	
311	**练习 1**：`out_proj` 是 `[hidden_size, local_linear_z_dim]`，注释说它是 row-parallel 且「the layer all-reduces the partial hidden sum under TP」。结合 u2-l2，解释为什么线性层在 TP 下需要 all-reduce，而全注意力层的 qkv 投影不需要？
312	**答案**：线性层的输入投影 `in_proj_qkvz` 按 head 切行（等价 Megatron 的列切），每个 rank 对**完整 hidden** 的 normed 输入只算出自己 head 子集的 z 维输出；`out_proj` 把 z 维映射回 hidden，各 rank 持 `[hidden, z_local]`，乘出的 hidden 是**部分和**，必须 all-reduce。全注意力层的 q/k/v 投影虽然也切行，但它们的输出（各 rank 的 head 子集）直接进注意力内核，不需要聚合到 hidden——聚合发生在 `o_proj` 之后的 hidden 维。两种层的通信点都在「回到 hidden 维」的那一刻：全注意力在 o_proj 后、线性在 out_proj 后，代码里都是同一行 `all_reduce_hidden`。
313	
314	**练习 2**：为什么 `a_log` 和 `norm_weight` 要从 checkpoint 的 bf16 加宽成 f32 存储，而 `dt_bias` 保持 bf16？
315	**答案**：`a_log` 参数化遗忘门衰减（指数里的量），`norm_weight` 逐元素缩放 GDN 输出——两者都是**乘性/指数路径**上的敏感参数，bf16 的 8 位尾数会在长序列递推中累积误差；`dt_bias` 与 a_log 相加后同样进入 softplus，但作为加性偏置其本身精度损失影响相对小，且 decode 内核签名按 bf16 消费它（`gated_delta_rule_decode_batch_into` 的参数，[src/batch_decode.rs:876-877](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L876-L877)）。这是精度与内核接口的折中，装载代码注释明确指向 `tensor_f32_cow` 的「widened exactly at load」路径。
316	
317	**练习 3**：conv1d 的 TP 分片为什么不能直接用 `Shard::flat(qkv_dim)` 一刀切？
318	**答案**：因为 conv1d 权重是**展平**的 `[qkv_dim × kernel_dim]` 向量，每个通道的 4 个 kernel tap 连续存放；同时通道布局镜像融合 qkv 的行段 `[q|k|v]`，而 q/k 段按 key head 切、v 段按 value head 切，三段宽度不同。所以分片要把 qkv 的三段偏移各自乘以 kernel_dim 换算成「tap 单位」再拼接（`conv1d_shard_segments`，[src/weights/layers.rs:409-415](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L409-L415)）。一刀切会把某个 head 的 tap 组切一半给邻居 rank。
319	
320	## 5. 综合实践
321	
322	**任务：亲手画出两种层的数据流图（本讲规格指定的实践）。**
323	
324	画出**一批 token**（seq 长度为 S）经过一个 `TransformerBlock35` 的完整数据流图，FullAttention 与 LinearAttention 各画一份。要求：
325	
326	1. **骨架两种图共享**：`hidden [hidden, S]` → `input_layernorm`（(1+w) RMSNorm）→ 注意力子层 → 残差相加得 `hidden_mid` → `post_attention_layernorm` → MLP（`gate_up_proj` GEMM → SiLU·mul 融合 → `down_proj` GEMM → TP all-reduce）→ 残差相加得新 `hidden`。
327	2. **每个节点标注函数名**，以两条真实路径为准：
328	   - prefill 骨架：[src/prefill.rs:238-302](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L238-L302)（`batched_rms_norm_offset_into` / `add_batch` / `gemm` / `silu_mul_fused_batch_into` / `all_reduce_hidden`）；
329	   - decode 骨架：[src/batch_decode.rs:653-717](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L653-L717)（`rms_norm_batch_offset_into` / `add_batch_into` / `gemm_into` 等 `_into` 变体——注意 decode 路径写进预分配缓冲，为图重放服务）。
330	3. **FullAttention 分支**展开为五步：q/k/v 三 GEMM → 融合预备（QK-norm + partial RoPE + K/V 落页）→ paged attention → gate → `o_proj` + all-reduce；函数名取 [src/prefill.rs:305-446](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L305-L446)。
331	4. **LinearAttention 分支**展开为五步：融合 GEMM（`gemm_rows_into` 取 qkv/z/b/a 四带）→ conv1d → GDR chunkwise → gated RMSNorm（z 门）→ `out_proj` + all-reduce；函数名取 [src/prefill.rs:448-552](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L448-L552)。

333	
334	**验收标准**：合上图能在 5 分钟内向同伴讲清——(a) 两种层共享哪些节点、差在哪个子图；(b) `all_reduce_hidden` 在两张图的哪两个位置出现、为什么恰好是那里；(c) 为什么 LinearAttention 图里没有 KV 池、它的「记忆」画在哪。
335	
336	（本实践为源码阅读型，无需 GPU。若想锦上添花，可在有 GPU + 权重的环境跑 `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler`，对照日志里逐层加载的 `layer_types` 输出检查你的图——待本地验证。）
337	
338	## 6. 本讲小结
339	
340	- `TransformerBlock35` = 共有的双 norm + MLP + 因层而异的 `LayerKind`；分发源头是 `config.layer_types[i]`，加载期决定变体、前向期 `match` 分派，两条索引流（`full_idx` 进 KV 池、`linear_idx` 进递推状态）各自编号。
341	- **层结构体只装权重**：全注意力的 K/V 在模型级分页池（只按 8 个全注意力层开池），线性注意力的状态在调度器侧 `RecurrentState`——权重与状态分离是图重放与前缀缓存的前提。
342	- `FullAttentionLayer` 的三个特性：gated Q（q_proj 行含 per-head `[q|gate]` 交错块，TP 必须按 head 整块切）、head 共享 QK-norm、partial RoPE；prefill 把 norm+RoPE+落页融成一个内核。
343	- `LinearAttentionLayer` 的装载期融合：四个 checkpoint 投影 vstack 成 `in_proj_qkvz`/`in_proj_ba` 两个矩阵，前向一次 GEMM 一组；conv1d 通道布局镜像 qkv 带的段偏移；`a_log`/`norm_weight` 加宽 f32。
344	- 前向五步序（norm → 注意力 → 残差 → norm → MLP+残差）在 prefill 与 decode 两条路径同构，差别只在 `_into` 后缀（预分配缓冲）与内核族选择；TP 通信点统一在「回到 hidden 维」处（`o_proj`/`out_proj` 之后）。
345	
346	## 7. 下一步学习建议
347	
348	本讲看清了层的**结构与调用序**，但刻意绕开了两类细节，正好是下一单元的入口：
349	
350	- **u3-l1（全注意力层）**：深入 `KvView`/`KvBuffer` 分页布局、RoPE 表的按需扩容（`ensure_rope_cache_covers`）、hd256 内核族的张量布局参数——把本讲 4.2 的「落页」一步放大。
351	- **u3-l2（线性注意力层）**：精读 `RecurrentState`/`LayerRecurrentState` 的 `[H,K,V]` f32 状态布局、`per_layer_dims` 的元素数公式、`LinearStatePointerTables` 指针表——把本讲 4.3 的虚线状态画实。
352	- 想先看这两种层在**整批解码**里如何混跑，可跳读 u4-l2（batch_decode 混合批），再回头补 u3 的状态细节。
353	
354	建议顺手做一个自测：合上讲义，只凭 [src/ops.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/ops.rs#L1-L29) 的 29 行重导出清单，把每个函数名归类到「全注意力用 / 线性注意力用 / 两者共用 / 模型级」——归类完毕，本讲的地图就内化了。

# 层结构：TransformerBlock35 与两种注意力层

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 解释 `config.layer_types[i]` 如何在**加载期**决定一个 decoder 层装配成 `FullAttentionLayer` 还是 `LinearAttentionLayer`，以及在**前向期** `LayerKind` 枚举如何驱动逐层分发。
2. 逐一说出 `FullAttentionLayer` 与 `LinearAttentionLayer` 各自持有的权重张量、它们的形状、以及哪些权重在 TP 下被切分、哪些被复制。
3. 沿 `prefill_layer`（prefill 路径）与 `batch_decode_kernels_graph`（decode 路径）定位 norm / RoPE / 投影 / 门控 / 残差的精确调用顺序，并写出每一步调用的 `ops::` 函数名。
4. 理解一个贯穿全讲的结构性事实：**层结构体里只有权重，没有运行时状态**——全注意力的 KV 在模型级共享分页池里，线性注意力的递推状态在调度器侧的 `RecurrentState` 里。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲默认你已读完 u2-l1（配置校验）、u2-l2（TP 几何）、u2-l3（权重加载管线）。再用三段话补齐直觉：

**混合架构回顾**。Qwen3.5 不是「一种注意力 + 32 个相同层」，而是两种层 interleaved 排布（4B 为 8 层全注意力 + 24 层线性注意力）。全注意力层把历史存进 KV cache，显存随上下文线性增长；线性注意力层（Gated DeltaNet，下称 GDN）把历史压缩进一个**固定大小**的递推状态矩阵，显存不随上下文变化。`config.json` 里的 `layer_types` 数组逐层声明这一点，u2-l1 已看到它在加载期被升格为 `LayerType` 二值枚举。

**权重与状态的分离**。本讲的所有「层结构体」（`TransformerBlock35` 等）只装**不可变权重**。可变状态全部在层结构体之外：全注意力层的 K/V 写进 `Qwen35Model` 持有的分页 KV 池（`kv_buffer`），线性注意力层的递推状态/卷积状态由调度器侧的 `RecurrentState` 持有。这个分离是 CUDA Graph 指针稳定性和前缀缓存能工作的前提（后续单元展开）。

**RMSNorm 的 (1+w) 变体**。Qwen3.5 的所有 norm 都是 RMSNorm 的 offset 变体：输出乘以 `(1 + w)` 而不是 `w`，因此代码里到处是 `rms_norm_*_offset_into`（见 [src/prefill.rs:253-255](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L253-L255) 的注释「We need the (1+w) variant」）。 checkpoint 里存的是 `w` 本身，偏移在内核里加。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| [src/weights/layers.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L1-L509) | 本讲主战场：`TransformerBlock35` / `FullAttentionLayer` / `LinearAttentionLayer` / `LayerKind` / `MLP35` 的定义与加载器，外加 `WeightSource` 的 TP 分片描述 |
| [src/weights.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L1-L602) | `Qwen35Model` 组装：逐层加载循环、KV 池按全注意力层数开池、`output_logits_into` |
| [src/prefill.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L236-L564) | prefill 前向：`prefill_layer` 五步骨架 + 两种注意力的 prefill 实现 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 层分发：从 `config.layer_types[i]` 到 `LayerKind`

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`TransformerBlock35` 是「一个 decoder 层」的容器。它把层内成员分成两类：

- **两种层共有的**：`input_layernorm`、`post_attention_layernorm`、`mlp`——不管注意力是哪种，这两个 norm 和 MLP 的权重形状与用法完全一致；
- **因层而异的**：`attn: LayerKind`，一个双变体枚举，装着 `FullAttentionLayer` 或 `LinearAttentionLayer`。

分发的源头是配置：u2-l1 里 `layer_types: ["linear_attention", ...]` 字符串数组被校验层升格为 `LayerType` 枚举（[src/config/model.rs:17-20](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L17-L20)）：

```rust
pub(crate) enum LayerType {
    FullAttention,
    LinearAttention,
}
```

于是「第 i 层是什么」在模型加载时就固定下来，前向期只需 `match`。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

加载期分发（weights.rs → layers.rs）：

```
for i in 0..num_hidden_layers:
    prefix = "model.language_model.layers.{i}"
    layer_type = config.layer_types[i]          # 加载期已知
    TransformerBlock35::load(src, prefix, layer_type)
        ├─ FullAttention   → FullAttentionLayer::load(src, "{prefix}.self_attn")
        ├─ LinearAttention → LinearAttentionLayer::load(src, "{prefix}.linear_attn")
        ├─ input_layernorm  ← "{prefix}.input_layernorm.weight"        # 共有
        ├─ post_attention_layernorm ← "{prefix}.post_attention_layernorm.weight" # 共有
        └─ MLP35::load(src, "{prefix}")                                # 共有
```

前向期分发（prefill 与 decode 两个路径同构）：

```
linear_idx = 0; full_idx = 0
for layer in layers:
    normed = rms_norm(hidden, layer.input_layernorm)
    match layer.attn:
        FullAttention(attn)   → 全注意力内核族; full_idx += 1
        LinearAttention(attn) → GDN 内核族;     linear_idx += 1
    hidden_mid = hidden + attn_out
    normed = rms_norm(hidden_mid, layer.post_attention_layernorm)
    hidden = hidden_mid + mlp(normed)
```

注意两个独立计数器：`full_idx` 索引**共享 KV 池里的层号**（池只按全注意力层数开），`linear_idx` 索引**递推状态数组里的层号**。这正是「权重在层结构体里、状态在层外」的直接后果。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

层容器与枚举。`TransformerBlock35` 的四个字段就是上面流程图的具象（[src/weights/layers.rs:103-109](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L103-L109)）：

```rust
pub(crate) struct TransformerBlock35 {
    pub(crate) input_layernorm: DeviceVec,
    pub(crate) attn: LayerKind,
    pub(crate) post_attention_layernorm: DeviceVec,
    pub(crate) mlp: MLP35,
}
```

`TransformerBlock35::load` 按 `LayerType` 二选一装配注意力子层，共用同一个 `prefix` 下的 norm 与 MLP 权重名（[src/weights/layers.rs:114-132](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L114-L132)）。关键差异是 checkpoint 张量前缀：全注意力层在 `self_attn` 下，线性注意力层在 `linear_attn` 下——HF checkpoint 就是这么命名的，加载器原样对齐。

`LayerKind` 除了是分发枚举，还提供两个类型收窄的 `Option` 访问器（[src/weights/layers.rs:63-77](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L63-L77)）：`full_attention()` / `linear_attention()`。它们让「按类型过滤层」的代码不必写嵌套 match，例如 GEMM 调优时从所有全注意力层采样 `q_proj`、从所有线性层采样 `in_proj_qkvz`（[src/weights.rs:490-509](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L490-L509)）。

组装循环在 weights.rs：逐层取 `config.layer_types[i]` 传入 `load`（[src/weights.rs:221-232](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L221-L232)）。加载完成后，KV 池按 `num_full_attention_layers()`（对 `layer_types` 计数得出，[src/config/model.rs:131-136](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L131-L136)）开池（[src/weights.rs:261-269](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L261-L269)）——24 个线性层在这座池里没有座位，这是混合架构最直观的显存结构。

前向分发在两条路径上各出现一次，形态相同：

- prefill 路径：`match &layer.attn` 分派到 `prefill_full_attention` / `prefill_linear_attention`（[src/prefill.rs:261-284](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L261-L284)），match 之前还用引用匹配先算出注意力输出维度（`local_full_attn_q_dim` vs `local_linear_z_dim`）；
- decode 路径（CUDA Graph 捕获用）：同样的 match，全注意力走批量 paged 内核并 `full_idx += 1`，线性注意力走按槽位指针表的 GDN 内核并 `linear_idx += 1`（[src/batch_decode.rs:653-684](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L653-L684)）。

顺带看清 MLP 的形状约定（两种层共享，[src/weights/layers.rs:86-101](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L86-L101)）：checkpoint 里 `gate_proj` 与 `up_proj` 是两个矩阵，加载时 `vstack` 成一个 `gate_up_proj`，前向一次 GEMM 出 `[gate | up]` 两段，再用 `silu_mul_fused_batch_into` 做门控乘法——这与 u2-l3 讲过的「装载期融合」是同一手法。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `LayerKind` 不用 trait 对象（`Box<dyn AttentionLayer>`）而用枚举？
**答案**：枚举是封闭集合且大小静态已知：两种变体的权重形状完全不同（`FullAttentionLayer` 全是 `DeviceMatrix/DeviceVec`，`LinearAttentionLayer` 还有 `CudaSlice<f32>`），枚举让 `match` 成为穷尽性检查——新增层类型时编译器强制更新所有分派点；同时避免虚函数表间接调用，字段可以直接按 TP 分片规则逐个装载，加载代码（`TransformerBlock35::load`）与分派代码共享同一类型信息。

**练习 2**：`full_idx` 与 `linear_idx` 为什么不能合并成一个 `layer_idx`？
**答案**：因为两套状态系统各自独立编号。KV 池只为全注意力层开（`num_full_layers` 层），第 3 个全注意力层在池里的层号是 2，即使它在模型里是第 7 层；递推状态数组只为线性层开，编号同理。`layer_idx`（模型层号）只用于日志和错误上下文（如 batch_decode.rs 混合路径的 `with_context`），不用于索引状态。

**练习 3**：`input_layernorm` 与 `post_attention_layernorm` 在两种层上的形状和用法有区别吗？
**答案**：没有。二者都是 `[hidden_size]` 的 `DeviceVec`，从同一组 checkpoint 名字加载，在全注意力层与线性层上以完全相同的 `rms_norm_batch_offset_into` 调用使用（对比 [src/prefill.rs:257](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L257) 与 [src/prefill.rs:291](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L291)，与层类型无关）。这就是它们被放进 `TransformerBlock35` 而不是两个注意力层结构体的原因。

### 4.2 全注意力层：gated Q、QK-norm、partial RoPE 与 paged KV

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`FullAttentionLayer` 是「标准」Transformer 注意力加三个 Qwen3.5 特有的 twists：

1. **gated attention**：`q_proj` 的输出不只含 Q，还含每个 head 的一个**门控标量带**。HF/PegaInfer 的内核把 `q_proj` 的行解释为「每个 head 先 `head_dim` 行 Q、再 `head_dim` 行 gate」的 per-head 交错块（注释见 [src/weights/layers.rs:417-420](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L417-L420)）。注意力算完后用 gate 做 sigmoid 乘法。
2. **QK-norm**：Q 和 K 在 RoPE 之前各过一次 head 共享的 RMSNorm（`q_norm`/`k_norm` 都是 `[head_dim]`，广播到所有 head）。
3. **partial RoPE**：只旋转每头前 `rotary_dim = head_dim × partial_rotary_factor` 维（u2-l1 已推导），cos/sin 表在模型加载时预计算（[src/weights.rs:240-248](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L240-L248)），属于模型而非层。

维度派生（[src/config/model.rs:139-146](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L139-L146)）：`full_attn_q_dim = num_attention_heads × head_dim`，`full_attn_kv_dim = num_key_value_heads × head_dim`。注意 `q_proj` 矩阵的行数是这个的两倍（Q + gate）。GQA：`num_key_value_heads < num_attention_heads` 时多头共享 KV，组比率是 TP 不变量（u2-l2）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

prefill 路径（[src/prefill.rs:305-446](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L305-L446)）：

```
输入: normed_batch [hidden, seq]
1. q_full = gemm(q_proj, normed)        # [heads*head_dim*2, seq]（Q 与 gate 交错）
   k     = gemm(k_proj, normed)         # [kv_heads*head_dim, seq]
   v     = gemm(v_proj, normed)         # 同上
2. 融合预备内核（一个 CUDA kernel 做三件事）:
   a. Q/K 各自 RMSNorm（q_norm/k_norm）
   b. Q/K 前 rotary_dim 维做 partial RoPE（查 cos/sin 表）
   c. K/V 直接写进分页 KV 池（按 page_indices 定位页）
   输出 q_prepped
3. 批量 paged attention: attn_out = softmax(QK^T/√head_dim)·V
4. gate 内核: attn_out *= sigmoid(gate 带来自 q_full)
5. out = gemm(o_proj, attn_out) + TP all-reduce
```

decode 路径（[src/batch_decode.rs:112-214](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L112-L214)）结构相同，差异有二：第 2 步换成 decode 专用融合内核 `qk_norm_partial_rope_batched_decode_hd256_into`——它只做 QK-norm 与 partial RoPE（Q 从交错 `q_full` 取出写入 `q`，K 原地处理），**不碰 KV 池**；落页藏在第 3 步的包装函数里：`paged_attention_batch_decode_hd256_into` 先调 `scatter_decode_kv_into_paged` 把本步 K/V 写入池，再发射注意力内核（[pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/qwen35.rs:205-219](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/qwen35.rs#L205-L219)）。所以两条路径的「谁写池」位置不同：prefill 在 prep 内核、decode 在 attention 包装的开头。第 3 步内核本身二选一：批量小且 GQA 组比率在编译清单内（u2-l2 的 P2c 门）走 split-KV 两阶段归约内核（`paged_attention_batch_decode_split_hd256_into`），否则走单内核。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

权重与形状声明（[src/weights/layers.rs:15-28](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L15-L28)）：

```rust
pub(crate) struct FullAttentionLayer {
    /// Q projection including gate: [num_heads * head_dim * 2, hidden_size]
    pub(crate) q_proj: DeviceMatrix,
    /// K projection: [num_kv_heads * head_dim, hidden_size]
    pub(crate) k_proj: DeviceMatrix,
    /// V projection: [num_kv_heads * head_dim, hidden_size]
    pub(crate) v_proj: DeviceMatrix,
    /// Output projection: [hidden_size, num_heads * head_dim]
    pub(crate) o_proj: DeviceMatrix,
    /// QK norm weights: [head_dim] (broadcast to all heads)
    pub(crate) q_norm: DeviceVec,
    pub(crate) k_norm: DeviceVec,
}
```

加载器逐个标注了 TP 分片方式（[src/weights/layers.rs:135-146](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L135-L146)）：

- `q_proj` 用**专用**的 `gated_q_proj`：切分必须按 head 整块切，保持每个 head 的 `[q 行 | gate 行]` 相邻，不能对融合后的行做平坦对切（实现见 [src/weights/layers.rs:421-431](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L421-L431)，单测 [src/weights/layers.rs:493-508](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L493-L508) 验证了 rank1 从自己第一个 head 的 Q 行起步）；
- `k_proj`/`v_proj` 按 `kv_rows`（KV 头维行切），`o_proj` 按 `q_cols`（列切，配合 attention 输出的行切，attention 输出本 rank 只产本 rank 头的结果，列切 o_proj 后各 rank 出部分 hidden 和，再 all-reduce）；
- `q_norm`/`k_norm` 是 `[head_dim]` 的 per-head 广播权重，**不切分**，每个 rank 整取。

前向三步中最值得精读的是那个「一个内核做三件事」的融合预备调用（[src/prefill.rs:337-373](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L337-L373)）：`ffi::prefill_attention_hd256_prep_paged_cuda` 一次吃进 `q_full/k/v` 原始投影、`q_norm/k_norm`、`cos/sin` 表和分页池指针，吐出 norm+RoPE 后的 `q_prepped` 并把 K/V 落页。函数名里的 `hd256` 就是 u2-l1 内核门的 head_dim=256 约定。第 3 步批量 paged attention 用 `ffi::batch_prefill_paged_cuda_hd256`（[src/prefill.rs:375-423](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L375-L423)），sm_scale 为 \( 1/\sqrt{256} \)。第 4 步 gate 应用是独立小内核 `ffi::attention_gate_batch_hd256_cuda`（[src/prefill.rs:425-438](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L425-L438)）。最后 `o_proj` GEMM 后调 `all_reduce_hidden`（[src/prefill.rs:442-445](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L442-L445)）——单 GPU 时它是 no-op，TP 时做 NCCL sum。

decode 版内核选择逻辑在 [src/batch_decode.rs:126-192](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L126-L192)：先三个 `gemm_into`，再融合 `qk_norm_partial_rope_batched_decode_hd256_into`，然后按 `SPLIT_DECODE_MAX_BATCH` 与编译期 GQA 组大小二选一 paged 内核，gate 与 o_proj 收尾（[src/batch_decode.rs:194-213](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L194-L213)）。这些函数名都能在算子重导出面 [src/ops.rs:22-25](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/ops.rs#L22-L25) 里查到来源。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `q_norm`/`k_norm` 是 `[head_dim]` 而不是 `[num_heads, head_dim]`？
**答案**：因为 Qwen3.5 的 QK-norm 权重在所有 head 之间共享（注释明确写着 "broadcast to all heads"，[src/weights/layers.rs:25-27](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L25-L27)）。每个 head 对同一组 `[head_dim]` 权重做 RMSNorm。这也顺带使它在 TP 下天然无需切分：任何 head 子集用的都是同一份权重。

**练习 2**：attention 计算完之后、`o_proj` 之前，输出张量的行数是多少？TP=2 时 `o_proj` 为什么是列切？
**答案**：行数是 `local_full_attn_q_dim = local_num_attention_heads × head_dim`——本 rank 的头算出的本 rank 头维结果。`o_proj` 形状 `[hidden, num_heads×head_dim]`，其「输入侧」是 attention 输出、已被 head 切分，所以按 q 维列切后每个 rank 对完整 hidden 出**部分和**，经 `all_reduce_hidden` 求和得到完整输出。这是 Megatron 式 attention TP 的标准列切 q/k/v + 行切 o 布局，只是这里以「行切投影产部分 hidden」的视角表述。

**练习 3**：gate 应用为什么放在 attention 之后、而不是投影时直接乘进 Q？
**答案**：gate 调制的是注意力**输出**（value 加权和），不是注意力权重本身。若乘进 Q 会改变 softmax 分布（等价于缩放 logits），语义完全不同。内核名 `attention_gate_batch_hd256_cuda` 与调用位置（attention 输出缓冲 `attn_out_batch` 上原地修改，[src/prefill.rs:425-438](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L425-L438)）都体现了这一点：`out = attn_out ⊙ sigmoid(gate)`。

### 4.3 线性注意力层：Gated DeltaNet 的权重与一次前向

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`LinearAttentionLayer` 实现的是 Gated DeltaNet。直觉版：每个线性注意力层维护一组 per-head 的**状态矩阵** \( S \)（形状概念上 `[K, V]`），每个 token 到来时做一次「遗忘 + 写入」的递推更新，然后用当前 query 从状态里读出输出。示意形式（本 crate 的精确状态布局与内核数学在 u3-l2 精读，此处只给直觉）：

\[ S_t = \alpha_t \cdot S_{t-1} \;(\text{遗忘门衰减}) \; + \; \text{新写入}(\beta_t, \mathbf{k}_t, \mathbf{v}_t), \qquad \mathbf{o}_t = S_t\, \mathbf{q}_t \]

其中 \( \alpha_t \) 由 `A_log`/`dt_bias` 参数化的衰减得出，\( \beta_t \) 是写入强度（beta 投影），「Delta Rule」指新写入是对预测误差的修正而非盲目叠加。与传统 RNN 的区别在于更新是**外积形式**的，可以分块（chunkwise）并行——这正是 u1-l2 讲过的 Triton AOT 生成的 GDR chunkwise prefill 内核所做的事。

这层的输入侧还有两个配角：

- **causal depthwise conv1d**：QKV 投影结果先过一个核宽 4 的因果逐通道卷积（带 `conv_state` 记住跨 chunk 的尾拍），给线性层一点短程上下文记忆；
- **gated RMSNorm**：GDN 输出用 z 投影做 SiLU 门控的 RMSNorm（`rms_norm_gated_batch_into`，权重是 head 共享的 `norm_weight`）。

与全注意力层最大的结构差异：**这层没有任何 KV cache**。历史全部活在 `RecurrentState`（调度器侧持有）的 `layer_state.state`（f32）与 `layer_state.conv_state`（bf16）里，尺寸恒定。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

加载期（[src/weights/layers.rs:148-189](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L148-L189)）——checkpoint 按四个独立投影存储，装载期融合成两个矩阵：

```
in_proj_qkv + in_proj_z  --vstack-->  in_proj_qkvz   # 行序 [qkv | z]
in_proj_b  + in_proj_a   --vstack-->  in_proj_ba     # 行序 [beta | alpha]
conv1d.weight   → conv1d_weight（展平 [qkv_dim × kernel_dim]，通道序镜像 qkv 带）
dt_bias / A_log → 按 value head 分片（A_log 装载时从 bf16 加宽为 f32）
norm.weight     → norm_weight（[value_head_dim] f32，head 共享，整取不切）
out_proj        → 列切（行并行：各 rank 出部分 hidden 和，层内 all-reduce）
```

融合的收益（注释原话）：「one GEMM per group instead of four launches」——decode 路径整层只发 2 次 GEMM 就拿到 qkvz 和 ba。

前向期 prefill（[src/prefill.rs:448-552](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L448-L552)）：

```
输入: normed [hidden, seq]
1. qkv = GEMM(in_proj_qkvz 的 [0, qkv_dim) 行带)
   z   = GEMM(in_proj_qkvz 的 [qkv_dim, +z_dim) 行带)   # 同一矩阵两次行带读取
   b   = GEMM(in_proj_ba 的 [0, H_v) 行带)
   a   = GEMM(in_proj_ba 的 [H_v, +H_v) 行带)
2. qkv_conv = conv1d(qkv, conv1d_weight)  # 因果逐通道卷积，更新 conv_state
3. gdr_out  = GDR chunkwise 内核(qkv_conv, b, a, dt_bias, a_log)  # 读改 layer_state.state
4. normed_out = gated RMSNorm(gdr_out, norm_weight, gate=z, act=SiLU)
5. out = GEMM(out_proj, normed_out) + TP all-reduce
```

decode（[src/batch_decode.rs:845-906](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L845-L906)）同样五步，但两处不同：第 1 步对融合矩阵各发**一次**完整 `gemm_into`，之后用 `columns()` 视图切行带（不再分两次 GEMM）；第 2、3 步换成 decode 专用内核，通过**按槽位的设备指针表**（`state_ptrs`/`conv_state_ptrs`）直接寻址每个请求的固定地址状态——这是 CUDA Graph 重放指针稳定性的关键，u4-l3 展开。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

权重清单与注释非常完整（[src/weights/layers.rs:30-55](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L30-L55)），几个要点直接读注释即可：

- `in_proj_qkvz`：行 `[0, local_linear_qkv_dim)` 是 qkv、之上是 z，行序由 `linear_qkv_shard_segments` 约定；
- `in_proj_ba`：行 `[0, H_v)` 是 beta、之上是 alpha；
- `conv1d_weight`：从 `[qkv_dim, 1, 4]` 展平，**通道布局镜像 qkv 带**——所以 TP 分片时用与 qkv 相同的段偏移乘上 kernel dim（[src/weights/layers.rs:409-415](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L409-L415)）；
- `a_log`/`norm_weight`：bf16 存储在 checkpoint、装载时加宽为 f32（经 `tensor_f32_cow` 路径），因为衰减与 norm 对精度敏感。

TP 分片最讲究的是 qkv：checkpoint 把全局行存成 `[所有 q 行 | 所有 k 行 | 所有 v 行]` 三段，每个 rank 从**每段里**切出自己的 head 局部片再拼接，使 rank 拿到的行保持 `[q_local | k_local | v_local]`（[src/weights/layers.rs:386-407](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L386-L407)，注释里点名的「gated-q lesson」：绝不能跨段重排，q 行按 key head 计数、v 行按 value head 计数）。配套单测 [src/weights/layers.rs:473-491](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L473-L491) 用 16k/32v head 的 fixture 验证两 rank 的段拼起来恰好无重叠覆盖全局。

维度上，`z` 维 = `linear_num_value_heads × linear_value_head_dim`（[src/config/model.rs:155-157](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L155-L157)），且 local z 维等于 local v 维（[src/config/tp.rs:225-228](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs#L225-L228)）——z 作为门控与 GDN 输出同宽，才能在 gated norm 里逐元素相乘。

前向侧的两个状态外置点（[src/prefill.rs:504-514](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L504-L514)）：`layer_state = &mut recurrent.layers[*linear_idx]`，conv 内核拿走 `&mut layer_state.conv_state`，GDR 内核拿走 `&mut layer_state.state`——层结构体 `attn` 自始至终只有不可变借用。GDR chunkwise 调用（[src/prefill.rs:516-531](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L516-L531)）同时吃进 `qkv_conv/b/a/dt_bias/a_log`、输出 `gdr_out` 并原地推进状态。gated norm（[src/prefill.rs:533-544](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L533-L544)）的激活函数显式传 `GatedNormActivation::Silu`。

decode 版的行带读取与装载行序的对应关系（[src/batch_decode.rs:858-897](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L858-L897)）：`bufs.qkvz.columns(0, qkv_dim)` 取 qkv 带、`columns(qkv_dim, z_dim)` 取 z 带、`bufs.ba.columns(0, value_heads)` 是 beta、`columns(value_heads, value_heads)` 是 alpha——注释点明「row order is the one the loader stacked the weights in」，装载期融合与消费期行带是同一份契约的两端。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`out_proj` 是 `[hidden_size, local_linear_z_dim]`，注释说它是 row-parallel 且「the layer all-reduces the partial hidden sum under TP」。结合 u2-l2，解释为什么线性层在 TP 下需要 all-reduce，而全注意力层的 qkv 投影不需要？
**答案**：线性层的输入投影 `in_proj_qkvz` 按 head 切行（等价 Megatron 的列切），每个 rank 对**完整 hidden** 的 normed 输入只算出自己 head 子集的 z 维输出；`out_proj` 把 z 维映射回 hidden，各 rank 持 `[hidden, z_local]`，乘出的 hidden 是**部分和**，必须 all-reduce。全注意力层的 q/k/v 投影虽然也切行，但它们的输出（各 rank 的 head 子集）直接进注意力内核，不需要聚合到 hidden——聚合发生在 `o_proj` 之后的 hidden 维。两种层的通信点都在「回到 hidden 维」的那一刻：全注意力在 o_proj 后、线性在 out_proj 后，代码里都是同一行 `all_reduce_hidden`。

**练习 2**：为什么 `a_log` 和 `norm_weight` 要从 checkpoint 的 bf16 加宽成 f32 存储，而 `dt_bias` 保持 bf16？
**答案**：`a_log` 参数化遗忘门衰减（指数里的量），`norm_weight` 逐元素缩放 GDN 输出——两者都是**乘性/指数路径**上的敏感参数，bf16 的 8 位尾数会在长序列递推中累积误差；`dt_bias` 与 a_log 相加后同样进入 softplus，但作为加性偏置其本身精度损失影响相对小，且 decode 内核签名按 bf16 消费它（`gated_delta_rule_decode_batch_into` 的参数，[src/batch_decode.rs:876-877](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L876-L877)）。这是精度与内核接口的折中，装载代码注释明确指向 `tensor_f32_cow` 的「widened exactly at load」路径。

**练习 3**：conv1d 的 TP 分片为什么不能直接用 `Shard::flat(qkv_dim)` 一刀切？
**答案**：因为 conv1d 权重是**展平**的 `[qkv_dim × kernel_dim]` 向量，每个通道的 4 个 kernel tap 连续存放；同时通道布局镜像融合 qkv 的行段 `[q|k|v]`，而 q/k 段按 key head 切、v 段按 value head 切，三段宽度不同。所以分片要把 qkv 的三段偏移各自乘以 kernel_dim 换算成「tap 单位」再拼接（`conv1d_shard_segments`，[src/weights/layers.rs:409-415](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L409-L415)）。一刀切会把某个 head 的 tap 组切一半给邻居 rank。

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.
